title: DecisionDebt: Know what a decision breaks | Company Brain | FalkorDB Graph Hacks
description:
Know what a decision breaks before you make it.

Track: Company Brain (Track 03) — WeMakeDevs x FalkorDB Graph Hacks.

DecisionDebt connects a company's people, teams, projects, documents, services and decisions in FalkorDB. It traces which services and projects a proposed decision affects, with exact source excerpts behind each relationship. A bounded agent investigates uncertainty and proposes local remediation drafts for human approval.

Live read-only demo: http://decisiondebt.52.202.25.181.sslip.io:8081/
Repository and complete local setup: https://github.com/himanshu748/decisiondebt
Graph model: https://github.com/himanshu748/decisiondebt#graph-model
Cypher queries: https://github.com/himanshu748/decisiondebt/blob/main/backend/app/graph/queries.py
Recorded real LLM proof: https://github.com/himanshu748/decisiondebt/blob/main/evidence/agent-traces/llm-proof.json

The genuine OpenRouter investigation inspected missing Token Cache ownership, both conflicting Session Broker owner claims, and the unlinked OrionAuth mention. Owners remain unassigned where evidence is missing or conflicting. The document mention supports qualified review, not a dependency claim.

This is an edited walkthrough of actual browser captures using fictional Aster Works data. The original silent MP4 is unchanged; English captions are supplied separately. Local task approval and import/retraction are recorded demonstrations. The public deployment disables every write route and provider call.

AI disclosure: Codex generated most of the implementation, tests and styling. Participant contribution and personal-verification fields are explicitly left for the participant to complete in the README: https://github.com/himanshu748/decisiondebt#ai-coding-disclosure
